# NP Hiring — Site Information for AI Systems
# llms-full.txt — Extended version of llms.txt

> NP Hiring (nphiring.com) is a specialized job board for Nurse Practitioners in the United States, covering every NP specialty plus the wider APRN cohort across all 50 states.

## Mission

Help every Nurse Practitioner find the right role through a transparent, data-rich job board built specifically for NPs.

## Platform Overview

### Job Listings
- Live inventory changes daily; no fixed headline count is published here. For a
  current machine-readable snapshot, fetch https://nphiring.com/feed.xml (RSS 2.0,
  newest active listings) or the sitemap index at https://nphiring.com/api/sitemaps/index
- Sources: 8 employer applicant-tracking systems — Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, SmartRecruiters, Ashby, BambooHR, JazzHR, Workable
- Updated: daily
- Expired, filled, and dead-link postings are removed from feeds and sitemaps rather than left to rot
- Salary shown whenever the employer's posting provides it — we do not fabricate or estimate pay for individual listings
- Searchable by: keyword (/jobs?q=), location, specialty, setting, job type, and experience level

### Specialties Covered
- FNP — Family Nurse Practitioner
- AGNP / AGACNP — Adult-Gerontology (primary and acute care)
- PNP — Pediatric Nurse Practitioner
- NNP — Neonatal Nurse Practitioner
- WHNP — Women's Health Nurse Practitioner
- ACNP — Acute Care Nurse Practitioner
- PMHNP — Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
- CRNA — Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist
- CNM — Certified Nurse Midwife
- CNS — Clinical Nurse Specialist

### Category Pages (45)
Category hubs cover seven taxonomy axes:
- Setting: remote, telehealth, inpatient, outpatient, travel, urgent-care, home-health
- Job type: full-time, part-time, contract, per-diem, locum-tenens, 1099
- Specialty: family-practice, adult-gerontology, pediatric, neonatal, women-health, acute-care, emergency, psychiatric-mental-health, oncology, cardiology, primary-care, hospitalist, dermatology, orthopedic, aesthetics, pain-management, palliative-hospice
- APRN roles: anesthesia (CRNA), midwifery (CNM), clinical-nurse-specialist (CNS)
- Experience level: entry-level, new-grad, mid-career, senior
- Employer type: hospital, private-practice, community-health, va, correctional
- Population served: geriatric, veterans, lgbtq

All category pages live under https://nphiring.com/jobs/<slug>.

### Geographic Coverage
- All 50 US states + DC
- State job pages under /jobs/state/<state-slug>
- Per-category state pages under /jobs/<slug>/<state-slug> for the state-eligible categories
- Per-category city pages under /jobs/<slug>/city/<city-slug> across ~4,000 US cities
- Browse index at /jobs/locations

## Career Resources

- /salary-guide — NP salary guide, with a page per state
- /salary-guide/specialty — NP salary by specialty
- /resources — Licensure and career tools, including a state licensure checker
- /resources/1099-vs-w2 — 1099 vs W-2 for nurse practitioners
- /resources/fpa-guide — Full practice authority by state
- /resources/private-practice-guide — Starting an NP private practice
- /blog — Career guides, per-state licensure guides, and industry insights
- /job-alerts — Email alerts for new NP jobs
- /faq — Frequently asked questions

## For Employers

- /post-job — Post an NP job listing
- /for-employers — Employer hiring solutions
- /for-employers/resources — Employer hiring guides
- /for-employers/resources/how-to-hire — How to hire a nurse practitioner
- /for-employers/resources/job-description-guide — Writing an NP job description
- /for-employers/resources/job-description-templates — NP job description templates
- /pricing — Listing options
- /companies — Browse employers with active listings
- /for-programs — For NP program directors

## Editorial Standards

- /editorial-policy — How content is researched, sourced, and reviewed
- Cited statistics on our pages carry a named source and an as-of date; descriptive
  market context is labelled as the estimate it is rather than dressed up as a cited
  statistic
- Job-level salary is reproduced from the employer's posting, never modeled

## Data Access

- Sitemap: https://nphiring.com/sitemap.xml
- Sitemap index: https://nphiring.com/api/sitemaps/index
- RSS feed (newest active jobs): https://nphiring.com/feed.xml
- Job alerts: https://nphiring.com/job-alerts
